research only: attempted to find a server-side pre-filtered music listing (matching the AgendaLX/Teatro Municipal do Porto category-query precedent) — this endpoint returns HTTP 403 to a plain client. Filtering is therefore applied to the already-parsed record set instead (discovery.mjs's filterMusicRecords()), using the source's own per-item tag text, still deterministic and still source-provided, never inferred.

findings.total_pages_observed: exactly 2 (terminal navbar on page 2 carries no further pagSeguinte link)
findings.stable_identifier: Each item's own first-party /pt/eventos/{slug}/ permalink (present on both the wrapping image link and the 'Ler Mais' link) — used as source_record_id, the same honest judgement call already made for Teatro Municipal do Porto.
findings.date_time: Free text, no time-of-day ever stated. Six distinct real shapes observed live and handled by ingestion/cm-gaia-eventos/observation-adapter.mjs's parseGaiaDateText(): single day, same-month 'e'-joined pair, same-month 'a'-joined range, cross-month 'a'-joined range (same year), cross-month-and-year 'a'-joined range, and genuinely empty. certainty is honestly DATE_ONLY (never FLOATING_LOCAL — no time-of-day exists to certify) when a shape is recognised, else UNKNOWN — never fabricated.
findings.music_filter: The listing's own per-item category tag (e.g. '# música', '# desporto', '# infância', '# literatura', '# exposições', '# artes', '# formação', '# cinema') is retained verbatim and lower-cased by discovery.mjs; filterMusicRecords() keeps only the exact tag 'música'. A dedicated server-side filtered URL (search.php?q=música&Tags=19) was found but returns HTTP 403 to a plain client — see request 4 above.
findings.venue_identity: No venue/location field is exposed anywhere in this bounded search — neither the listing nor a sampled event detail page. Every Observation is therefore honestly venue_name=null/location_text=null and resolves UNRESOLVED, matching the existing cm-odivelas-agenda-cultura precedent exactly. No resolver branch was added.
